test_opentelemetry_tracing_diffusion_pip: test OpenTelemetry tracing in the diffusion pipeline by sending image generation requests with traceparent headers
test_spans_exported_with_traceparent: test that scheduler_dispatch and gpu_forward spans are exported when a W3C traceparent header is provided
test_spans_without_traceparent: test that diffusion spans are produced as a new root trace when no traceparent header is sent
test_batch_requests_tracing: test that multiple batch image generation requests each produce their own set of traced spans
run_tracing_integration_tests: run the pytest integration test suite for OpenTelemetry tracing in the sglang diffusion server
